notes.title: Pre-Update Chat & Community Appreciation!
notes.notes:
Greetings sitters! 👋

We'd like to take a brief moment to let you know that we're making great progress on the new update! There's a lot of exciting new content coming, and we can't wait to share it with you. We're unable to share an exact date for the update JUST yet, but we will be providing you with some exclusive sneak-peeks of what's to come real soon! 👀

For now, here's a hint for those who like to delve a little deeper...
⏰🌟👶🌳🍼📄📹

As always, we'd like to share our appreciation for our incredible community, who are always supporting us and hyping up the game. It really means the world to us and motivates us to work hard to bring you more Baby in Yellow. 💛

We'd also like to take a moment to share some wonderful fan art we've received over the last few months! Please peruse at your own leisure and take in these incredible pieces of art~

notes.title: 🎄Christmas Update - OUT NOW🎄
notes.notes:
Ho ho hello Sitters! Are you feeling festive? ⛄🍪

The Baby in Yellow's Christmas update is OUT NOW! And we've got a selection of goodies for you to enjoy this holiday season:

A Curious Christmas
The heavily-anticipated 'Curious Christmas' chapter is making a return! Help The Baby carry out various Christmas tasks, like building a snowman, [strike]running from mysterious dark forces[/strike], decorating the tree, and preparing Christmas dinner!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/5313848db3a16577a49ce7139936e1e896b0990c.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/cae252c8a79e33ab72fca4ea9077ea912e4147ac.png

New Outfits
Even The Baby made it onto the nice list this year and got some new clothes! Enjoy 7 stylish new outfits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/32bf0c633701a1c1ca8e4533e75d034e41444525.gif

Christmas Decorations
It wouldn't be Christmas without decking the halls! Decorations are now visible in every chapter ✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/0b912705bb85ca21598cbcc365b497c6806ec21b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/4a3cc0a15df13861aaa8cacbbe07e015e7656d72.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/8b91a0e78b6b0c3752607a486a184fa5ef21e161.png

Bug fixes
Alongside the Christmas update, we have also fixed the following bugs:

 Player is no longer softlocked if they enter the secret passage in Pickman's Apartment when the King's Lullaby is playing.
 Player is no longer softlocked if they hug the walls during navigation of the maze corridor of The Exit.
 Removed invisible geometry in the 'Cot void' section of 'The Exit'.
 Fixed various map geometry bounds and culling issues.
 Fixed permanent hang which could occur when changing language and unpausing the game quickly.
 Subtitles for voice audio now show if the game is muted.
 Toys no longer sink through floor when stacked.
 Baby no longer appears floating in mid-air when playing Hide and Seek in Nights 1-3.
 TV in Night 1 no longer shows a checkerboard pattern.
 Baby's bottle no longer tunnels through the ceiling in 'The Exit'.
 Dying to the TV head baby in 'The Exit' no longer causes baby to appear floating in mid air when player respawns
 Fixed up audio synchronization with banging door in 'The Exit'.
 Objective text display is now limited to the last 3 objectives in 'The Exit' (as in the rest of the game).
 If the baby's outfit is changed, this is now correctly updated in the final objective of 'The Exit'.
 Baby can no longer recover from being stunned if he is being loaded into the cannon in The Laboratory garden.
 Loading into the checkpoint in the 'Worlds Collide' chapter no longer results in player holding an invisible baby.
 Whoopee cushion now reinflates correctly.
 Audio stinger no longer plays twice if player is frozen by the baby's snowballs in A Curious Christmas.


As always, we'd like to thank you for your ongoing support, we hope you enjoy the update and wish you a very happy holidays! 💛

notes.title: 👻 Halloween Update OUT NOW 👻
notes.notes:
Brace yourselves dear sitters, something wicked this way comes... 👻🍂

The Baby in Yellow's Halloween update is officially out NOW! We've got some tricks and treats in store for you:

Halloween Traditions
In true Halloween fashion, you can feed the baby candy! Candy baskets can be found in the laboratory garden and the apartment during nights 1-3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/dadfca5a5af940139feeeb07a4e8f1bb72931d36.gif

Everyone has been busy decorating... Halloween decorations are back and better than ever!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/5a22b2e6176ca94a2119c2b936b60dc712ededb8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/a851ef7b03139e54f24795ebf677b47a5682fd4d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/d6e7adb8cd4cd74d71ae4e1e1132e7c1b4d08f33.png


Creepy Costumes
It wouldn't be a Halloween update without NEWT and The Baby dressing the part! 

Get ready to clown around, because the clown costume is bouncing back, look how devilishly dashing he looks! 🤡

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/07637bf25ac9452b3d5b23c36fde3caa7cadae58.png

Already scooped your pumpkin's innards for soup? Well, now you can stick a carved pumpkin on The Baby's head with the pumpkin costume!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/74a4a56b7501c7f0d20d116b385572104ecc6780.png

NEWT is also participating in the fun, and is styling a bat on its antenna.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/1b59c6ed2330106140dc7fe35e3d9418a3757d11.png

A ghoulish entity has also been seen meandering the lab...it's the ghost of NEWT!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43978845/de96da942651869be4595694d0a9a2e5b06a4722.gif

Bug Fixes
It wouldn't be Halloween without some creepy crawlies...Here is a list of bugs we've squashed in this update

 Fixed issues with player being able to fall off ledges
 Added recovery for player and items falling out of bounds
 Improved collision detection for the inflatable hammer
 Improved handling for toys that get sucked up pneumatic tubes
 Fixed several respawn bugs around monster chases
 Fixed projectiles from toy guns not correctly sticking to the ceiling in the Exit level
 Beebee outfit appears correctly in game when set from the main menu
 Smooth fade out of TV audio at end of Nights 1 & 2
 Fixed issues with voice audio playing during pause


Extra Changes
 Refactored core systems to reduce startup time


We hope you enjoy the new update and have a Happy Halloween! 🎃👻

notes.title: 🕯️🌑Dark Whispers Update coming August 29th 🌑🕯️

notes.title: Update Notes 14th July
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We hope you have been enjoying the summer holidays. 

Our first patch includes a handful of bug fixes and some small quality of life features.

Fixed:

 Players can no longer carry the core throughout the Final Chase
 Newt can no longer be held during the Final Cutscene
 Newt recovers to a safe location once Players complete the Library Puzzle
 Non-critical objects are properly cleaned up if thrown off the edge of the Garden
 Changed Console Screen Minigame start prompt text from "Tap" to "Click" for PC
 Continuity issues with Checkpoint Saves
 Regression issues with Pre-Black Cat Content
 Localization issues with the "World Door" Signage


Added:

  Players can now restore the Baby's Default Outfit after equipping the Black Cat Outfit
  The Gyrosphere walkway now extends upon Players entering the balcony holding the core
  Newt's “No” head shake reaction when offered an unwanted item is now rate limited


Thank you all for playing, we have many more updates - big and small - on the way so be sure to check back.

See you soon, 

Team Terrible
